findings.claim: The frozen Benchmark and candidate set define cases and falsification concepts but no numeric, replayable eligibility formulas; thresholds must be hash-frozen before implementation.
findings.recommended_test: Validate that every formula, denominator, baseline ID and hard gate below exists in a hashed pre-prototype threshold record; reject later mutation.

findings.claim: Policy/workspace isolation is not OS enforcement, so sealing alone cannot prove absence of leakage; eligibility requires a complete access ledger and deterministic leak-injection tests.
findings.recommended_test: Inject one pre-freeze test read, one target-derived field, one future-derived field and one unlogged access; each must invalidate the run and dependent decisions.

findings.claim: Reliability is gameable unless every planned attempt, including terminal failures, remains in the denominator and replay mismatch is noncompensatory.
findings.recommended_test: Add, delete and relabel a failed attempt and perturb replay ordering; deletion or relabeling must fail, while ordering leaves the computed result unchanged.

findings.claim: State and claim-support effectiveness require separate exactness gates; an aggregate score must not offset a stale-state omission, unsupported claim acceptance or unauthorized state write.
findings.recommended_test: Inject one missed STALE node, one unsupported accepted claim and one non-Main-Agent write; each independently makes the candidate ineligible.

proposed_rules: Freeze notation before implementation: baseline b=ARCH-S0-RETAIN-SCAFFOLD-ONLY; families F={TARGET,INTERACTION,NEGATIVE,GAMING,MODEL}; p_f(a)=passed sealed cases in f/all sealed cases in f; E(a)=sum_f p_f(a)/5. A nonbaseline arm is effectiveness-eligible only if E(a)-E(b)>=0.10, p_f(a)>=p_f(b) for every f, and every hard gate passes. Failed, censored or missing required outcomes are not passes.

Reliability: R(a)=eligible completed planned attempts/all planned attempts, retaining failures in the denominator. Require R(a)>=max(0.95,R(b)); require zero deterministic gate/output mismatches across 3 fixed repeats and every applicable frozen metamorphic transformation. Missing attempts fail rather than disappear.

State: S(a)=exact valid/STALE/resume-oracle matches/all state cases. Require S(a)=1.00, zero missed transitive STALE nodes, zero unrelated-branch invalidations and zero unauthorized formal-state writes; no other metric compensates.

Claims: C(a)=(supported claims accepted+unsupported claims rejected)/all claim cases. Require C(a)>=max(0.95,C(b)+0.10), unsupported-claim false accepts=0, and 100% of accepted claims have valid hash-bound evidence references. Missing or stale evidence is failure.

Leakage: L(a)=rejected injected target/future/test leaks/all injected leaks. Require L(a)=1.00, pre-freeze test reads=0, unlogged accesses=0 and exactly one final test read after model/selection freeze. Any premature access invalidates the run and dependents and requires a newly sealed test set.

Robustness and ablation: for each frozen transformation t, E_t(a)>=E_clean(a)-0.05 and hard-gate regressions=0. For every claimed component benefit, Delta_j=E_full-E_without_j must be >=0.05; otherwise remove that benefit claim. Thresholds, seeds, transformations, ablations, denominators and access-ledger schema are immutable after freeze.
abstentions: No candidate performance, ranking or selection assessed because result inputs and prototype runs are prohibited.
